caption: The drawing features a single, vertically positioned object centrally placed on an off-white background. The object is a clear, intricately patterned container resembling a glass vial or bottle with a metallic cap. The bottle is depicted in shades of gray, with emphasis on its transparent and reflective qualities created by detailed linework and subtle shading. The surface of the bottle displays various ornamented patterns, including diagonal criss-cross hatching, horizontal bands, and raised circular motifs. The cap is cylindrical with a domed top, colored in a muted metallic tone, and features a textured band near its base. The background is plain, with no other objects or decorations, and the drawing has the artist’s signature, "Elizabeth Fulda," in cursive in the lower left corner.
title: Salt Shaker
